subject: Beaver Moon supermoon 2026
query: is the november full moon a supermoon
title: Is the November full moon a supermoon? Yes, on Nov. 24
answer: Yes. November's Beaver Moon is a supermoon. It turns full on Tuesday, Nov. 24, 2026, at 9:53 a.m. EST (14:53 UTC), and it is the first of a run of supermoons that peaks with December's Cold Moon. Look for it rising in the east around sunset on Nov. 23 and Nov. 24.
body:
"Supermoon" is a popular term, not an official astronomical one. It describes a full moon that happens when the moon is near perigee, the closest point in its slightly oval orbit. Using NASA's commonly cited definition, Space.com and National Geographic both count the Nov. 24 full moon as a supermoon. The Farmers' Almanac puts the moon about 360,765 km (224,170 miles) from Earth at the moment it turns full, with perigee following on Nov. 25.

Will it look bigger? A little. A supermoon can appear up to 14% larger and 30% brighter than the year's smallest full moon, according to NASA figures quoted by both outlets, but against an average full moon the difference is about 7%, and most people can't tell by eye. The moon looks largest near the horizon right after it rises, an optical illusion that has nothing to do with distance.

Because the exact full phase falls during daytime in the U.S., the best views are the evenings of Nov. 23 and 24, when the moon is more than 99% lit. The Farmers' Almanac lists moonrise on Nov. 24 at about 4:17 p.m. in New York, 4:09 p.m. in Chicago, 4:29 p.m. in Denver and 4:44 p.m. in Los Angeles. Early risers can also catch it low in the west before dawn on Nov. 24, close to the Pleiades star cluster.

Next up: the Cold Moon on Dec. 23, 2026 (8:28 p.m. EST), the closest full moon of the year, and the Wolf Moon on Jan. 22, 2027. National Geographic and the Farmers' Almanac call November the first of three supermoons in a row; Space.com counts four, including February 2027.
in_the_news: The Beaver Moon turns full on Tuesday, Nov. 24, 2026, two days before Thanksgiving.

faq.q: What time is the full moon on Nov. 24, 2026?
faq.a: 9:53 a.m. EST, which is 6:53 a.m. PST and 14:53 UTC. The moon looks full the evening before and the evening of.

faq.q: Why is it called the Beaver Moon?
faq.a: Late autumn is when beavers finish their lodges and store food for winter, according to the almanacs. It is also called the Frost Moon.

faq.q: Is the December 2026 full moon a supermoon too?
faq.a: Yes. The Cold Moon on Dec. 23, 2026, is the closest full moon of the year, according to the Farmers' Almanac.

faq.q: Can a supermoon affect the weather or sleep?
faq.a: No evidence links supermoons to weather. They do cause slightly higher "king" tides along coasts.
